data.narrative:
Atmo is a Series A artificial intelligence and software company founded by Alex Levy and Johan Mathe. The company has raised $29.1M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 9 private frontier-tech firms and 1 public comparable (Palantir), including Reflection AI, Physical Intelligence, Black Forest Labs, and Field AI at similar or adjacent stages.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using the $29.1M raised as a proxy for post-money valuation, applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A-to-later-stage progression, yielding $58M. Peer-median analysis examines four same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables with a median valuation of $4.4B and a range of $2.0B to $25.0B, implying $4.4B for Atmo.

The triangulated analysis produces a wide range: $49M (low), $2.2B (median), and $5.1B (high). The stage-progression method yields a materially lower result than peer comparables, reflecting both the early-stage capital deployed and the steep valuation multiples observed in the AI & Software sector. Key uncertainties include revenue trajectory and unit economics relative to the peer set, as well as whether near-term funding events might anchor valuation at either the lower or upper end of this range. The median of $2.2B should be treated as indicative rather than determinative given the limited revenue visibility typical at Series A.
